web.title: Performance Portable BLAS3 Micro-Kernel Generator - Springer
web.description: The software framework facilitates the semi-automatic generation of microkernels that can be incorporated into existing libraries, like the BLAS implementation BLIS. This paper presents results for the GEMM function of BLIS on a diverse array of processors that support x86, ARM, and RISC-V SIMD and vector instruction sets.

web.title: AOCL-BLAS Boosting GEMM Performance for Small Matrices - AMD
web.description: At the heart of most high-performance GEMM implementation lies the 5-loop algorithm, a hierarchical structure that decomposes matrix multiplication into nested loops for blocking, packing, and micro-kernel execution. This design is highly effective for large, square matrices, where cache reuse and computing throughput can be fully exploited.

web.title: Register Blocking: A Source-to-Source Analytical Modelling Approach for ...
web.description: Register Blocking is a critical compiler optimization for developing efficient micro-kernels in machine learning and linear algebra applications. It combines loop unrolling and scalar replacement to reduce memory load and store instructions, thereby increasing arithmetic intensity and improving performance.

web.title: Small Matrix Optimizations (SUP Path) | amd/blis | DeepWiki
web.description: The Small/Unpacked (SUP) execution path is an optimized code path in BLIS for operations on matrices that fall below certain size thresholds. This path bypasses the standard 5-loop algorithm structure, packing operations, and cache blocking to achieve better performance for small matrices.
